name: Discrete Ray Casting with Trilinear Reconstruction
definition: A direct volume rendering algorithm that uses discrete ray casting and a trilinear reconstruction filter to render volumetric data.
summary: Discrete Ray Casting with Trilinear Reconstruction is a direct volume rendering technique that improves visual quality by using trilinear interpolation within the ray casting loop, unlike its parent method which relies on bilinear interpolation of pre-sliced texture tiles.
